'''Andrzej Januszajtis''' (18 August 1928 – 22 January 2026) was a Polish physicist, academic and politician who served as the Chairman of the City Council of [[Gdańsk]] from 1991 to 1994.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://trojmiasto.wyborcza.pl/trojmiasto/7,35612,23819436,kocham-gdansk-za-to-ze-jest.html|title=inwestor buduje jak najwyżej, a konserwatorowi brakuje wyobraźni|author=Anna Dobiegała|language=Polish|date=27 August 2018|publisher=Wyborcza.pl Trojmiasto|accessdate=21 April 2019}}</ref> Januszajtis died on 22 January 2026, at the age of 97.<ref>{{cite news |title=Nie żyje prof. Andrzej Januszajtis, znawca historii Gdańska |url=https://www.trojmiasto.pl/wiadomosci/Nie-zyje-prof-Andrzej-Januszajtis-znawca-historii-Gdanska-n213540.html |access-date=23 January 2026 |publisher=Trojmiasto |date=23 January 2026}}</ref>
